_comment: Harness defaults; personal overrides go in settings.local.json (gitignored). `model` mirrors config models.session (/harness-doctor checks agreement). /harness-init appends the project's gate commands to permissions.allow (headless -p runs auto-deny anything non-allowlisted). The five guard hooks come from the installed lean-agent-harness plugin, not this repo. Why there are no deny rules on config/specs writes, and why hooks are a denylist not a sandbox: docs/sandboxing.md.
